summary: Claim that TurnReviewHost/seed_from_session receives the 1,024-item truncated projection from the dashboard poller.
Truncating the TUI dashboard poller to 1,024 items permanently removes earlier conversation history from TUI chat scrollback and search.
Claim that browser_transcript receives the 1,024-item truncated projection and can return fewer than 1,000 visible lines after filtering raw_only entries.
Dashboard unread counts, unread restart indicators, and last-message previews drop items once they slide past the 1,024-item polling window.
Claim that first_materialized_user_message stops at a user message whose text becomes empty after provisional_session_title strips hidden prompt context.
load_materialized_projection_tail computes latest_user_position via last_materialized_user_message, skipping user items with empty or whitespace-only rendered text.
first_materialized_user_message restricts stable_id to user:* and user-*, skipping restored user items with other valid stable IDs during title resolution.
load_materialized_projection_tail_from runs an O(history) COUNT(*) for unused omitted_items on every poll and resume seed, and its user-message queries can scan the full session index.
OwnedMcpApprovals::response for DSH delegates to allow_permission_response, which falls back to AllowAlways when AllowOnce is absent.
GET /api/v1/events rejects normal SSE EventSource reconnects with HTTP 400 whenever Last-Event-ID advances past the initial after_seq query parameter.
mj events stops observing Ctrl-C while blocked on stdout writes to a backpressured pipe.
Steering a running prompt emits a turn_started for the queued command while the later turn_ended names the original command without an accepted_ordinal, leaving the steered turn open.
Prompt RPC failures emit an API error event whose message is the literal 'error' instead of the diagnostic already journaled in the preceding Warning observation.
Filtered event replay uses (?2 IS NULL OR e.session_id = ?2) predicates that prevent SQLite from using the api_events_session(session_id, seq) index.
A failure in record_activity_stream wins the top-level server select, dropping the control future before its shutdown and cancellation tail runs.
InputResolved reads turn_id from current.active_turn at resolution time, which can be None or the next turn if Muse completes the prompt before ElicitationResolved is enqueued.
When provisioning fails and rollback cleanly deletes the provisional session, no API error event is persisted for the session ID already returned by POST /api/v1/sessions.
Unbounded wrapped quota height uses Constraint::Length(usage_quota_rows), which crowds out the chat input box in the capped inline viewport and short fullscreen terminals.
DeepSeek balance parsing only checks that balance amount strings are non-empty, allowing non-numeric strings to overwrite the last known good balance.

Deleting daemon_restart_without_a_baseline_does_not_hide_pending_work removes the sole test verifying that restarting an existing relay without a review-baseline ref leaves the ref absent rather than hiding pending edits.

Deleting a_harness_restart_gates_dispatch_until_the_session_is_configured_again removes the only worker-side regression test checking that HarnessRestarting closes dispatch until SessionConfigured reopens it.
Deleting embedded_npm_recipes_match_the_runtime_pins removes the only automated check keeping embedded Codex and Claude npm package.json files aligned with mj-core runtime pins.
Deleting the MCP wait socket test removes the only check that return_when: any and the default Codex timeout ceiling are sent on the wire over the subagent socket.
Deleting an_unanswered_handback_tells_the_child_to_call_again leaves the child-specific unanswered-handback retry advice completely untested.
Deleting reviewer_fast_mode_is_applied_when_advertised_and_optional_otherwise removes all ACP runtime coverage for reviewer fast-mode application and fallback when absent or rejected.
Deleting the worker project-memory snapshot test removes the only coverage of apply_project_memory_request for baseline/replica routing and snapshot installation.
Deleting muse_incomplete_install_requires_both_executables removes the only non-ignored test verifying that complete_install checks Muse's extra bin/muse executable.

Deleting an_unparsable_codex_config_is_reported_rather_than_overwritten removes a unit test on pin_accepted_bridge_selectors for invalid JSON input, which is intended pruning of an input-check unit test.

Confirmation::RecoverFailed renders unbounded session.last_error text above the action buttons in a single non-scrolling Paragraph clamped to terminal height, clipping the buttons off-screen when the error wraps.

Focusing Recover by default on Confirmation::RecoverFailed while the dashboard accepts repeated Enter events and drains buffered events before drawing allows a held Enter to advance through the prompt and non-EC2 resume wizard and submit recovery unintentionally.
Answering a turn-review role's elicitation spawns an additional permanent journal polling loop for that role.
Submitting a reviewer elicitation clears the dialog immediately without tracking the in-flight answer, so concurrent journal polls reopen the same form and a duplicate submission can fail the review.
Metadata-only raw checkpoints reuse `ARCHIVE_SCHEMA_VERSION_REVIEW_REFS` (schema 10) instead of bumping the archive schema version.

`collect_git_metadata_snapshot` sets `review_refs_metadata_only` to `!saved_refs.is_empty()`, so raw snapshots without `refs/mj/` refs are treated as full snapshots and can check out `head_commit` into a shared checkout on restore.

Removing the foreign-baseline refusal on restore allows a resumed review-enabled raw session to reach worker startup, where `initialize_review_baselines` unconditionally overwrites the other live session's `refs/mj/review-baseline` pin.
Prompts submitted while a config update is in flight are discarded by the ACP runtime while leaving the UI permanently stuck in Streaming state.
refresh_config_picker retains only numeric indices across ConfigOptionUpdate refreshes, allowing reordered or removed options/values to silently retarget a pending selection.
draw_config_picker under-allocates modal height by one row (desired_rows + 4 instead of + 5), leaving zero list rows when only one option or value exists.
When the terminal is smaller than 9 rows or at most 8 columns wide, the config picker renders nothing but still intercepts keys and applies selections on Enter.
Embedded newlines in option or value descriptions are preserved by truncate_line, causing multi-row ListItems that desynchronize the single-row-per-item scroll window.
Other connected dashboard clients skip composer disposal when the legacy default workspace is closed, allowing unsent drafts to be captured and later restored.
spawn_workspace_close reports the close as failed and skips explicit deletion cleanup if the follow-up runtime_snapshot or workspace-list RPC fails after close_workspace already succeeded.

close_workspace checks cancellation only once before close_session, so after an irreversible child stop finishes, close_session can start stopping subsequent children or the parent before the 100ms cancellation poll fires.
Workspace-close cancellation calls cancel_lifecycle on every session in the initial snapshot regardless of lifecycle owner or kind, risking cancellation of deferred cleanup or a subsequent resume.
discard_workspace_composers does not clear dashboard.standby_prompts, so standby drafts survive workspace closure and are adopted when a retained session is resumed.
Wide graphemes on continuation rows overflow the viewport width and are clipped when continuation_indent leaves only one display cell.
Entering a nested list in a tight list item overwrites the pending parent item prefix and merges parent and child text onto one line.
Rich mode discards Markdown link destinations and renders only the underlined label with no clickable hyperlink or visible URL.
Markdown table grid rendering measures rows independently and joins cells without column padding, misaligning columns and misjudging table width.
A header-only Markdown table that exceeds the viewport width disappears completely in the narrow fallback layout.
Sanitizing streamed chunks individually turns a chunk-boundary CRLF split into two newlines.
Every periodic redraw clones all cached transcript lines for the entire conversation before discarding off-screen rows.
A plan update arriving between streamed chunks of the same agent message splits the message into separate transcript entries.
The new Docker integration test starts agent-dev:latest and immediately asserts it has no baked worker, which fails once this commit's updated image is published.
Worker recovery and parked subagent wake still use digest-based host-binary refresh, overwriting the image-worker symlink with a host copy.
publish-agent-dev-image.yml has no concurrency control or HEAD check, so an older run finishing after a newer push can roll back :latest to a stale worker build.
mj-controller/docs/PODMAN.md still documents a bare `podman build` command that now fails due to the new required build arguments in Containerfile.agent-dev.
WorkerInstall::for_target selects the image worker before checking host overrides, silently bypassing MJ_WORKER_BINARY for uncommitted local edits at the same commit.
The image worker probe uses `test -e`, so a dangling symlink at /opt/mjolnir/mj-worker reports `absent` and silently falls back to a host copy instead of failing.
Dashboard close failures never open the new recovery dialog, leaving force destroy unreachable after the `x` shortcut is removed.
The added cross-harness lossy label causes resume profile rows to wrap inside a fixed-height, non-scrolling picker, clipping later choices and the warning off-screen.
Re-merging the cached login/target environment in hel_acp restores GIT_CONFIG_COUNT and GIT_CONFIG_KEY_* variables that configure_github_cli deliberately removed.
Login environment capture invokes the account shell with `-l -c`, which fails on login shells like `tcsh` that only accept `-l` as the sole argument.
Clearing the worker environment on re-exec drops SSH_AUTH_SOCK, breaking SSH-agent-authenticated Git operations and branch pushes on bare targets.
Worker re-exec clears the container-provisioned GH_TOKEN before configure_github_cli can copy it into the session token file or push-branch can use it.

On login-capture timeout, CancellableProcessExecutor kills only the shell's process group and then unconditionally joins pipe readers, hanging if a login profile spawns a session-detached helper holding stdout or stderr open.
spawn_shell strips GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN after applying spawn.env, deleting credentials explicitly supplied by an ACP terminal/create request.
Empty-bootstrap login capture breaks the documented custom container image contract by discarding image-defined ENV/PATH and requiring a working login shell and home directory.
Worker Diff and PushBranch re-exec with a cleared environment without restoring configured target_environment.
The agent-dev container login profile omits RUSTUP_HOME and CARGO_HOME, so the clean login bootstrap loses the Rust base image's installed toolchain.
Checkpoint Git subcommands are omitted from bootstrap_login_environment and continue to inherit launcher Git variables such as GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE.
The capacity-refresh failure response advertises log reference `capacity-poller`, but the warning emitted when the poller channel is closed omits that reference.

Unconditionally wrapping `resolve_local_repository` errors in `Refusal::precondition` turns Git execution, filesystem, timeout, and cancellation failures into HTTP 409 missing-remote refusals instead of HTTP 500 internal errors with a log reference.

Capacity refresh validates `target_id` against configured target IDs in HTTP validation but looks it up in `capacity_state` keyed by probe IDs, so valid configured target IDs receive the new 422 saying the target is not configured.
Concurrent model downloads share a fixed `.part` filename, allowing one worker to unlink the other's temporary file and rename a still-incomplete file into the final model cache path.
The new per-file model download title puts the full filename before the percentage and `Ctrl-R stop` hint, causing ratatui to clip both on ~48-60 column terminals.
Claim that `starting_dictation_shows_preparing_until_microphone_levels_arrive` downloads models on a cold cache because it calls `start_dictation`.
Claim that `busy_prompt_title` hides dictation setup progress and `Ctrl-R stop` when dictation starts during an active agent turn.
`dictation_prompt_title` reads the shared `state.status_line`, so an agent turn completing while models are downloading or loading overwrites the setup status with `turn done: ...`.
Legacy Row transcript positions saved from a partial view cannot be distinguished from full-history indexes.
Restoring a saved transcript position by start_seq selects the first entry when multiple visible items share an event ordinal.
Replacing a missing Codex thread after a failed session/load leaves session_updates_enabled false, dropping all live updates.
Pre-upgrade snapshots lack native_session_used and do not replay prior SessionOpened(resumed=true) or autonomous output, allowing silent replacement of populated threads.
A successful resume without replay or prompts does not set the bridge's native_session_used atomic, so an in-process bridge restart keeps native_session_may_have_history false.
Removing a queued prompt before dispatch transitions its state directly from Queued to Rejected, which native_session_may_have_history mistakenly treats as evidence the thread was used.
Adding native_session_used with serde(default, skip_serializing_if) without bumping RELAY_STATE_VERSION intentionally matches the existing RelaySnapshot compatibility convention.
Bare-session file reads pass the project directory's parent as the root boundary, allowing sibling-directory reads outside the checkout and misresolving project-relative paths.
Bundle export always refuses bare sessions with 'no commits beyond the session base' because bare checkpoints never populate committed_bundle against the session base.
Session diffs started in a repository subdirectory stage only that subtree into an empty scratch index, falsely reporting tracked files outside the subdirectory as deleted.
Diff export always fails with 'no session base recorded' for unmanaged bare checkouts because no base commit or branch is supplied.
capture_worktree_tree starts from an empty scratch index and runs git add -A, causing tracked files matching ignore rules to appear deleted in exported session diffs.
Exported patches corrupt non-UTF-8 text files because diff_between_trees decodes git diff output with String::from_utf8_lossy.
HTTP bundle exports await checkpoint_session directly on the request task, blocking Tokio workers on synchronous DB/subprocess/SSH calls and skipping rollback if the request is cancelled.
read_session_file checks canonical containment, regular-file type, and size on the path before a separate fs::read, leaving a TOCTOU window and allowing reads past MAX_SESSION_FILE_BYTES.
Bundle export verifies an unpinned checkpoint archive path that a concurrent checkpoint or close can delete before verification completes.
Managed worktree creation records source HEAD as base_commit but still passes literal 'HEAD' to git worktree add, risking a base mismatch if the source checkout moves in between.
Claimed that managed network workspace checkpoints exclude commits already pushed to origin, making bundle exports empty after pushing.
Replacing sessionwiki::index::recent with a metadata-only SQL query in named_like sets preview to None, dropping transcript excerpts for title- and project-only search matches.
Pasting a query into the Live search box discards the returned wiki search action, and removing the tab-switch search fallback leaves history tabs showing stale results.
rebuild_resume_rows runs the full build_resume_rows history merge even on unfiltered Live views where both the merged rows and zero hit counts are discarded.
Typing a new query on Live immediately counts stale cached dialog.wiki rows from the previous response as hit badges for the new query until the new search returns.
Terminal focus loss cancels the resume modal's form pointer state but leaves preview_scrollbar's drag state set, causing wheel events to be swallowed on focus return.
The focusable PreviousHit and NextHit preview arrow buttons render without any visual focus indicator when focused via Tab.
Deferred checkpoints return before packing and leak uniquely named target staging directories on disk.
RecoveryCoordinator drops an idle observation that arrives while a deferred copy still holds the gate and never re-evaluates it after clearing last_attempted_turn.
TurnReviewHost overwrites prompt_driven on consecutive Running views, dropping the automatic review for a completed user prompt when a self-started turn follows before an Idle view is observed.
A deferred manual checkpoint erases any previously recorded last_checkpoint_error instead of leaving the session row untouched.
Close (HoldThroughClose) still receives CheckpointDeferred from post-barrier checks and aborts close instead of waiting through or retrying.
installation_home performs synchronous std::fs::canonicalize during Config::setup_additions, which runs on the TUI event loop when Settings applies discovery results.
installation_home expands ~ during discovery deduplication while profile consumers use profile.home literally, causing a ~-spelled profile to suppress discovery of the working absolute home.
When canonicalize fails on a missing home behind a symlink and .., the lexical fallback pops the symlink component and can falsely match and suppress a distinct installation.

When a configured path under a symlinked ancestor has a missing intermediate component before .., the lexical fallback leaves the symlink unresolved and still duplicates the canonicalized discovered home.
On Windows, canonicalize returns a verbatim \\?\ path while the lexical fallback returns an ordinary drive-letter path, causing a mismatch and duplicate profile.

The 15-second SAVE_ACK_TIMEOUT in spawn_config_rename wraps both the daemon rename RPC and the subsequent blocking local config/store reload, so a reload timeout after daemon acknowledgement discards the reload and falsely reports that the daemon never acknowledged the save.

Import completion treats any SessionStarted { resumed: true } as a finished transcript replay, so an adapter supporting session/resume without load_session resumes without replaying history and causes the import to close it and report an empty transcript.
Reconstructing the selected session route from best-effort session_provenance lookup keyed by current cwd instead of carrying selected_role across SwitchSession existed before this diff.

Comparing roster.primary against a provenance-resolved entry from roster.available using primary_route_matches misclassifies a same-adapter, same-model restart fallback as an import whenever primary reasoning_effort is configured.

When the temporary source runtime emits UiEvent::Fatal during an import replay, the TUI never exits back to run_app, stranding the user in a dead source-adapter view after the original primary has shut down.

The new clipboard stale-read guard compares only input_generation and ClipboardTarget, so it still accepts pastes after tabbing between fields in the same elicitation or opening and closing a modal dialog without editing the composer.
Discarding a stale clipboard read leaves the "Reading clipboard…" progress notice on screen when image capability changes mid-read.
Local Docker probe timeouts and non-NotFound execution errors bypass DockerUnavailable and fall back to the old generic preflight error and remediation.
docker_daemon_not_running only checks two legacy Docker CLI substrings and misses newer Docker CLI "failed to connect to the docker API at ..." stderr output.

Classifying any matched daemon connection error as "its daemon is not running" with "Start Docker" advice is misleading when DOCKER_HOST or the active Docker context points to an unreachable endpoint.
is_missing_program in preflight.rs duplicates is_missing_command in controller/backend.rs.

Legacy local bare sessions whose configured profile directory does not yet exist at upgrade time are skipped by profile-home linking, causing checkpointing and worker restarts to point at a missing staged profile path.

Legacy macOS Claude sessions with a custom profile home actually ran from ~/.claude because CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR was left unset, so linking <worker_root>/profile to launch.json's harness_home redirects them to the wrong directory.

Upgraded legacy macOS Claude sessions with Mjolnir sub-agents enabled lose both Claude's native delegation tools and Mjolnir sub-agents after worker recovery because subagent_tools is enabled without staging the mj-agents MCP config into the linked home.
credential_sync_targets now performs synchronous symlink_metadata filesystem I/O on the TUI dashboard event loop for each running or checkpointing local bare session.
When provisioning fails or times out during session/new, the session ID is already recorded in Adapter.sessions, causing unanswered_refusal() to return None and mj acp to exit with status 0.
The post-resume prompt in the real-harness acceptance test supplies the expected marker rather than testing recall of pre-suspend conversation context.
If mj acp fails to exit on consumer EOF, Client.stop() times out twice (in the test and in cleanup) without ever killing or reaping the hung relay and adapter subprocesses.
Lab.cleanup() wraps all session destroy calls in a single try block, so a failure or timeout destroying one session skips destroying all remaining sessions before stopping the daemon.

Client.response() clamps Queue.get timeout to at least 0.01s without checking whether the deadline has expired, so continuous session/update notifications can keep it looping indefinitely past --timeout.
POST /api/v1/workspaces with the reserved name `default` returns HTTP 500 instead of a 4xx client error.
`mj new --workspace-id ''` bypasses the required-workspace check and triggers the controller's single-workspace auto-selection.
`mj new` reads the prompt and validates `--bundle`/`--project-directory` before checking for a missing workspace.
The workspace refusal reports `0 sessions` for a workspace (including newly visible `default`) that contains only inactive sessions.
Renaming the `default` workspace and then deleting its last session hides it and makes `refuse_legacy_default_name` reject recreating that name.
`mj acp` without `--workspace` can hang indefinitely in `list_workspaces()` if the daemon has closed admission for an upgrade.
`POST /api/v1/sessions` with `project_directory` and no workspace persists a quick bundle before returning 409 on a fresh instance.
`mj go` fails on a fresh instance in a directory named `default` or `Default` because it does not treat `default` as a reserved workspace name.
The combined `1 task, 1 shell <elapsed>` background status overflows the 16-column minimized Sessions status budget, dropping the elapsed time and truncating the label when a prompt is queued.
A fast post-start error in `acp::run` can record `Failed` before the queued `SessionStarted` event is processed, overriding the intended first-outcome-wins semantics.
`ServerSessionLaunchRegistry::begin` evicts the oldest launch ID unconditionally even if it is still `Starting`, dropping its eventual failure.
`serverLaunchFailure` calls `apiFetch` without a client-side request timeout.
An unrelated session published by another client matches `!knownSessionIds.has(session.session_id)` and stops the launch watcher before the requested launch resolves.
`acp::run` awaits the ACP `initialize` response without a timeout, so a silently hung adapter never triggers `reporter.failed`.
Provisioning creates `worker_root` with default permissions before the worker starts, so `WorkerRootOwner::acquire` leaves newly provisioned worker roots world-traversable (0755).

CLI startup (`acquire_start_lock` and `DeferredLogFile::write`) still creates `data_dir` and `logs` with plain `fs::create_dir_all`, leaving fresh instance data directories at 0755 before the controller runs.
Journal sealing and rewriting open deterministic `.new` staging paths with `create(true).truncate(true)`, preserving mode 0644 if a pre-upgrade crash left a stale `.new` file.
Clipped model and effort chips are still rendered with clickable chip styling when their full width exceeds the prompt border, but no hitbox is registered for the visible portion.
Prompt title chip hitboxes remain active underneath a center-fallback autocomplete popup that overlaps the prompt title row.
Model and effort chips claim all mouse event kinds in component_handles_mouse, causing the dashboard to clear an active text selection dragged across the prompt top border.
Clicking a model or effort chip opens the config picker without clearing keyboard focus from the View tasks or Sub-agents control, so those controls intercept subsequent keys.
The wide minimized Sessions pane title omits the urgency glyph and renders only 'Attention: N', losing the distinction between levels that share a color.
Returning Unreachable before checking review failure downgrades a running session with a failed review or findings forward from Failed to Unreachable when its worker is unreachable.
Desktop notifications for the new Unreachable attention level fall through to the wildcard arm in notification_body and report the last agent message or 'Finished'.
sessions_block gates the title badge on saved PaneSize::Minimized rather than effective sessions_minimized() in narrow layouts, but this behavior pre-existed this commit.
The MarkAllRead confirmation notice omits unreachable sessions even though they remain flagged and the commit updated the docs and command description to mention them.
stage_profile uses Path::exists() on the Muse model-catalog path, silently ignoring I/O or permission errors as if the catalog were absent.
muse_data_dir compares the configured profile home against the user's own Muse config home lexically, misclassifying symlinked or aliased paths as private homes.

muse_data_dir derives whether a profile is the user's native Muse home from the daemon's current XDG_CONFIG_HOME, losing access to the native catalog if the daemon runs without the custom XDG_CONFIG_HOME used at discovery.
The prompt readiness wait holds no upgrade activity permit, so an automatic daemon handoff can shut down the HTTP server after 2 seconds and drop the waiting prompt.
A prompt arriving after the worker handshake sets state to Running but before the first operational report sets capabilities.prompt is immediately rejected with 409.
ACP session/cancel arriving during the prompt readiness wait cannot withdraw the held prompt, so the cancelled prompt is still submitted once the worker attaches.
The side-source test still uses a 2-second timeout for PromptDone right after the commit raised the preceding ack wait to EVENT_DEADLINE.
The live-config persistence polling loop still uses a 5-second deadline even though the commit raised the test's shutdown wait to EVENT_DEADLINE.
Copied Muse auth.json files in the temporary smoke-test profile are claimed to be readable by other Unix users under a 022 umask.
native_muse_turn re-submits the live prompt if the ACP runtime restarts the bridge and emits a second SessionStarted with resumed=true.
Timeouts or unexpected stream closure in native_muse_turn panic and detach the spawned runtime task, letting TempDir drop and delete the profile while Muse processes may still be running.
Pinned field titles are rendered unwrapped in a single fixed row, permanently clipping long titles even when vertical space is available.
In 6- or 7-row ordinary question panes, reserving two body rows for the focused field's title and control leaves zero rows for the request message.
supervise waits for stdout and stderr pipe EOF via tokio::join! before publishing the child's exit status, causing terminal/wait_for_exit to hang when a background descendant inherits stdio.
ProcessGroup::kill_if_live skips signaling the process group once the shell's exit status is published, allowing backgrounded descendants with redirected stdio to survive kill, release, and teardown.

TerminalRegistry::shutdown kills and awaits each terminal supervisor sequentially with a per-terminal 5-second timeout, making teardown scale linearly and leaving later terminals running during earlier waits.
TerminalBuffer enforces output_byte_limit on raw bytes before lossy UTF-8 conversion and clamps a zero limit up to 1, allowing returned strings to exceed the requested byte limit.
CreateTerminalRequest omits the configured session environment (spec.environment) when spawning terminal children, passing only request.env on top of the daemon environment.
TerminalRegistry::output reads the output buffer before reading the exit status, allowing a race that returns an exit status paired with stale pre-final output.
shell_line leaves command unquoted even when args are supplied, so executable paths with spaces or shell metacharacters are word-split or shell-interpreted by sh -c.
Active client terminals are not tracked by the checkpoint barrier, so dispatch_pending can declare a checkpoint ready while a client terminal is still running and writing to the workspace.
Client terminals run in their own process groups detached from the worker's group, so bare-target teardown that signals the worker's process group with SIGTERM/SIGKILL misses live terminals.
Terminal IDs restart at term-1 on every ACP connection, colliding with earlier transcript entries across worker restarts and overwriting old tool-call outputs.
The managed session actor remains unleased during restart_worker_for_checkpoint, allowing concurrent prompts to be dispatched to the restarted worker before the checkpoint acquires its lease.

adopt_restarted_checkpoint_relay overwrites the newly leased actor connection with the older restarted proxy, which can leave the in-memory projection behind SQLite and fail the next sync with AlreadyApplied.
adopt_restarted_checkpoint_relay falls back to an unmanaged Standalone connection when handle.lease_connection() fails, bypassing the actor's exclusive lifecycle lease.
worker_connect_needs_restart misses a BrokenPipe error when a dead worker's relay proxy exits before the controller finishes writing the hello frame.
open_checkpoint_relay immediately kills and restarts the worker on an ambiguous proxy disconnect without retrying a fresh proxy or probing worker liveness.
inject_github_token passes the literal GitHub token in container runtime and SSH command-line arguments, exposing it via process listings.
use_github_https_urls rewrites non-GitHub SCP-style repository URLs into broken github.com HTTPS URLs because github_repository_from_origin falls back to owner/repo shorthand parsing.

install_git_plan unconditionally requires and attempts to install GitHub CLI in every managed container, breaking custom images that already have Git but lack gh and root/sudo or a supported package manager.
install_git_plan sets credential.https://github.com.helper with single-value git config --global under set -eu, which fails on images that already have multi-valued credential helpers.
inject_github_token unconditionally appends GH_TOKEN after target environment variables, silently overriding an explicit GH_TOKEN configured on the container target.
ReviewDispatch::launch validates each reviewer's hypothesis and then drops it before constructing the specialist's lane prompt.
ReviewerMcpServer::new compares the controller's relative dispatcher command against the worker's absolute worker_root on SSH bare and EC2 targets, preventing Guardian preapproval of mj-review.
Local filesystem path completions bypass the 5-second deadline and cancellation flag, holding a shared preflight slot indefinitely if local I/O stalls.
Arrow-key navigation in the path suggestion popup updates aria-selected without scrolling the highlighted row into view when the list overflows its 40dvh height.
Blurring the path input hides the suggestion list without clearing the pending debounce timer or aborting the in-flight fetch.
The path suggestion keydown handler lacks an IME composition guard, intercepting Arrow, Enter, and Escape keys during active IME composition.
The path input lacks combobox ARIA attributes linking focus to the suggestion listbox and its active option for screen readers.
In JournalReadMode::Recover, a corrupt terminated record exceeding RELAY_EVENT_BYTE_BUDGET causes read_bounded_line to return an error before the recovery branch runs, aborting the scan.
Claims that JournalReadMode::Recover and RelayJournalGap fields trigger dead_code warnings and break cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings in non-test builds.
RelayJournalGap.byte_len records line.len(), excluding the consumed terminating newline and leaving a 1-byte discrepancy against complete_bytes.
Running a command from the palette never adds it to Recent if the command also has pane_keys (such as Create session or Search sessions).
Editing the palette query preserves the previously selected Recent command instead of resetting selection to the top match, so Enter can execute a disruptive command whose description weakly matches.
The combined dashboard checks filtered ordered_sessions().is_empty() to decide if the workspace has any live sessions, misreporting filtered-out sessions as NoLiveSession.
Filtering out a collapsed project permanently removes its key from collapsed_project_keys because clamp_selections() prunes against the filtered project_keys().
Pasting text while editing the Sessions search query is silently ignored because handle_paste only handles component modals and Focus::Prompt.
Unhiding Create session from PALETTE_HIDDEN still leaves it unsearchable from Targets, Quota, and Workspaces because its scope is Scope::Sessions.
Worker activity updates that move the selected session out of the active state filter do not reconcile selection, leaving selected_session_id pointing to a hidden row.
The Sessions search filter matches only stored target_template_id instead of the displayed session_target_label, missing bare project targets and in-progress resume destinations.
Focusing the Sessions action row (which happens automatically when a filter matches no rows) disables Esc and state filter letters, breaking the advertised 'Esc clears the filter' recovery.
select_active_session checks the filtered ordered_sessions() list, silently failing to select a newly created or resumed session when an active filter excludes it.
Greedy character scanning in subsequence_score can commit to an earlier non-contiguous letter and score a literal word match below a scattered match.
apply_worker_summary unconditionally installs summarized_unread_agent_messages even when the selected session is currently visible on the dashboard.
Handling WorkerRequest::SessionSummary scans the entire event log (cloning and deserializing every adapter payload) when a session has no title or no completed turn.

Loading full history when opening a summary-hydrated worker advances the client cursor past any TurnCompleted without notifying recovery, and run_chat skips bootstrap recovery when given a prebuilt ChatState.
Summary hydration derives unread counts and agent_text_stream_open from rendered ChatState entries, diverging from the event-level stream rules used by live dashboard updates.
If ten newer non-assistant entries push assistant messages out of the hydrated preview tail, pressing Delete immediately destroys the live session without DESTROY confirmation.
apply_worker_summary replaces summarized_unread_agent_messages without clearing unread_agent_message_sequences, causing reconnects to double-count previously received unread messages.
Detaching updates last_viewed_event_sequence in controller state without refreshing worker poll targets, so reconnect summaries recount already-read messages.
A held Enter key that starts or confirms an import can deliver a Repeat event to Mode::Importing and immediately cancel the import.
The rename dialog renders RenameFocus::Field and RenameFocus::Save identically even though typing, backspace, and paste are ignored when Save has focus.
mj resume --wiki hardcodes import safety acknowledgements to false and exposes no flags for them, making noninteractive native imports with dirty checkouts or omitted directories always fail.
mj resume --wiki cannot restore archived container or bundle-backed sessions because they index an empty project and restore_wiki_session unconditionally requires a bare project directory.
Native wiki resume discards the indexed transcript path and searches only the stock harness home, failing for non-default profile homes or importing the wrong session on ID collision.
mj resume --wiki <native-id> --json prints plain-text import progress lines to stdout before the JSON result, producing invalid JSON.
Native wiki resume immediately POSTs the HTTP resume endpoint after socket import persistence, racing with asynchronous viewer snapshot publication and risking a 404 unknown session error.
The documented mine status in mj sessions --session <id> is unreachable because direct session lookup succeeds first and skips the wiki lookup.
mj resume --wiki <archived-id> without --workspace-id sends None, which the restore endpoint converts to an empty string that database validation rejects.

Adding DaemonAction::WikiSession and GET /api/v1/wiki/sessions/{wiki_id} without bumping PROTOCOL_VERSION causes upgraded clients to reuse older daemons and misreport 404s as missing indexed sessions.
Native wiki resume tells multi-workspace users to pass --workspace NAME, but Command::Resume never forwards the global --workspace flag.
Logout persistence failures return 500 after revoking in memory, but the web viewer neither catches the error nor keeps logout retryable once a subsequent 401 hides the app.
Already-open cookie-authenticated /api/v1/events SSE streams are not terminated when the viewer logs out.
revoke_viewer skips recording a revocation when the presented cookie has just expired, allowing a delayed renewal response for the same viewer to restore access.
Revocation expiry only uses the presented cookie's expiry and current session_ttl, which would be too short if the daemon were restarted with a reduced session_ttl.
When a held Move relay proxy disconnects before sealing, open_checkpoint_relay jumps straight to restarting the worker instead of trying a fresh relay connection first.

Dropping the held Move lease when the source proxy disconnects releases the actor reservation, letting deferred submissions such as GoalControl drain into a still-live source worker before seal or restart.
On a Move retry after queue admission has already started, preflight leases the running destination as source_relay and execute_move skips dropping it until the whole retry finishes.
ASCII quota bars draw 9 cells instead of 10 when a nonzero fractional cell rounds down.
truncate_line_to_width reserves only 1 cell for the ellipsis even though ASCII mode appends the 2-cell "..".
The voice control button hardcodes the Unicode microphone glyph in ASCII mode for both rendering and hitbox width.
Several dashboard and Setup controls still emit hardcoded Unicode glyphs when ASCII symbols are enabled.
The Recent messages modal truncates each notice to one line with no wrapping or horizontal scrolling, cutting off long failure tails.
Compact session row git truncation splits at the second space, dropping "HEAD" from "detached HEAD".
Changing the Symbols setting does not invalidate cached transcript or second-opinion rows, leaving stale glyphs and mismatched gutters in open conversations.
Composer hints still join shortcuts with " · " while splitting on theme::footer_separator() (" - " in ASCII), dropping all composer hints on narrow panes and leaking Unicode.
Notice history coalesces consecutive matching text without updating timestamp or severity, keeping stale time and routine styling when a failure repeats an earlier notice.
Stacked failure notices hardcode a Unicode middle dot "·" in the stored footer text instead of respecting the ASCII symbol set.
Stacked failure deduplication compares incoming failures against the formatted stack summary instead of the raw latest failure text, inflating the displayed count on repeats.
In Monochrome mode, disabled form controls and Sessions action-strip buttons render identically to normal unfocused controls.
Relative ages in the Recent messages modal stay frozen while idle because the dashboard clock signature does not include the notice log.
pin_accepted_codex_model reads CODEX_CONFIG only from launch overrides, clobbering login-shell CODEX_CONFIG settings when the supervisor overlays overrides onto the login environment.
CODEX_CONFIG_ENV is compiled on Windows while every reference is gated to Unix, triggering a dead_code clippy error.
acp-supervisor.json is written only once at worker startup, so an in-worker bridge replacement after a model change reopens Codex on the stale pinned model.

YOLO auto-approval exempts any permission request matched by is_plan_permission, which recursively scans titles and nested rawInput fields and can stall ordinary tool calls in interactive plan review.
Claimed nested scroll region from #conversation-side max-height: 25dvh conflicting with .conversation-side-content max-height: 40dvh on phones.
Tabbing from an empty composer editor to Attach or Send on phone widths clears composer-has-intent and hides the focused action button.
Viewer HTML, CSS, and JS were updated without bumping CACHE_VERSION in service-worker.js, risking mismatched cached shell assets after an upgrade.
Releasing a pointer outside promptForm after pressing Attach or Send leaves composerActionPointerDown stuck true.
At 320px phone widths, the fixed 138px right padding on the status summary clips single-digit three-part task counts behind an ellipsis.
Expanded combobox popups do not take pointer hit-testing precedence over later controls they visually cover.
Pressing Ctrl-S while a Setup choice popup is open collapses the combobox without closing the editor, leaving the choice editor stuck.
Open Model and Effort combobox popups retain a raw numeric pending index across background discovery updates, which can silently highlight and commit a different option.
ComboBox::render draws the preview text with a Paragraph without clearing the underlying cells first, leaving trailing characters from a longer committed value visible in Setup.
delete_empty_workspace_at allows deleting the reserved 'default' workspace, breaking all subsequent session creation and prompt recording.
Existing database tests in src/hel_database/tests.rs break under schema 14 due to 3-value positional session_contexts inserts and a v13 downgrade fixture that leaves v14 objects in place.
assign_new_session_workspace_at performs a non-atomic read-then-unconditional-update, allowing concurrent callers to silently overwrite an already-assigned workspace.
assign_new_session_workspace_at treats any session in 'default' as newly created, allowing existing or migrated default-workspace sessions to be moved despite the documented immutability invariant.
The SQL CHECK constraint limits name_key to 64 characters even though Unicode lowercasing can expand a valid <=64-character display name beyond 64 code points.
normalize_workspace_name uses str::to_lowercase instead of Unicode case folding, allowing case-equivalent names like Greek final/non-final sigma to bypass uniqueness.
The v14 migration test inserts its session only after migrating an empty database, so it never tests migrating a preexisting pre-14 session.
Pinned worker binaries stored under workers/pinned/<sha>/hel are never reclaimed after daemons exit, causing unbounded disk growth across rebuilds.
worker_binary_refresh_plan selects std::env::consts::ARCH for local containers rather than probing container architecture.
download_worker ignores previously verified downloads cached under workers/<version>/<triple>/hel after switching to workers/pinned/<sha>/hel.
copy_worker_source_to_cache does not verify that the source file stayed unchanged while being copied, allowing an in-place overwrite to pin a torn binary.
Awaiting synchronous worker-binary copying and fsyncing before binding the daemon listener can exceed the client's 8-second START_TIMEOUT.
publish_cached_worker reuses an existing pinned/<sha>/hel based on is_file() alone without verifying its SHA-256 digest.
download_worker permanently fails instead of redownloading when a cached file under workers/pinned/<sha>/hel fails checksum verification.
publish_cached_worker reuses a cached binary by content digest alone, retaining non-executable permissions even after the source permissions are fixed and the daemon restarts.
copy_worker_source_to_cache stages and fsyncs a full duplicate binary before checking if the digest is already cached, failing on low disk space and freezing the error for the daemon's lifetime.
Stored summary SQL queries use SQLite's space-only trim() and LIMIT 1 instead of Rust's whitespace/sanitization semantics, inflating unread counts and hiding earlier nonempty agent previews.
apply_prepared_materialized_session_summary writes a precomputed unread count from a stale read cursor and can overwrite a full projection at the same event ordinal.
load_materialized_session_summary_from runs multiple autocommit SELECT queries without a read transaction, allowing torn reads across concurrent relay commits.
last_materialized_user_message filters user rows by stable_id prefix (user:* / user-*) instead of body kind, skipping valid imported user messages with other stable IDs.
The minimized two-session Active pane height includes the second row's trailing spacer for a third session in the same project, triggering 'Terminal too small' one row early.
Codex session discovery aborts on any single malformed JSONL rollout before selecting an explicitly requested session.
`github_repository_from_origin` falls back to raw `owner/repo` shorthand on `git remote get-url` output, misparsing non-GitHub SCP remotes and relative Git remotes as GitHub repositories.
`restored_native_relative_path` was flagged for not normalizing relative or tilde-prefixed `workspace_root` paths before deriving Claude/Kimi session keys.
Kimi `--latest` ranks candidates by the `session_<uuid>` directory mtime, which does not update when existing session files are appended or rewritten.
Local imports set `base_commit` to local `HEAD`, producing an empty Git commit bundle so resuming onto a fresh remote clone fails whenever the worktree has unpushed commits.
Prepending SSH default options in `ssh_args_with_identity` overrides user-configured `ssh_args` and the shorter `ssh_directory_completions` timeout under OpenSSH first-match-wins rules.
Failed provisioning cleanup runs only after `provision.execute` succeeds, leaking containers when later plan steps fail, and explicitly skips `SshPodman` containers.
Import commands load full config and state before prompting and archiving, then unconditionally overwrite both files with stale snapshots, clobbering concurrent updates.
`read_claude_transcript` does not finalize an open turn at EOF, leaving interrupted Claude sessions in `WorkerPhase::Running` on resume so new prompts are rejected.
`locate_kimi_session` compares `--session` verbatim against `session_<uuid>` directory names, rejecting the bare UUID documented by the CLI.
Adding `[build] target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-musl"` in `.cargo/config.toml` breaks existing CI jobs on Linux, macOS, and Windows that invoke Cargo without `--target` or the musl target installed.
`cleanup_failed_provision` silently returns `None` when EC2 `run-instances` stdout cannot be parsed for an instance ID, omitting any warning that teardown was skipped for the tagged instance.
Retrying an interrupted close via `recover_interrupted_close_managed` does not persist `last_error` on failure, leaving a `Destroying` record without an error so the TUI disables Stop again.

The close cancellation gate reads the daemon's periodically refreshed `self.controller` cache rather than synchronizing with the close task's durable `Destroying` transition, leaving a race where Alt-X still cancels target teardown.

`session_projection` holds the non-reentrant `self.controller` mutex while calling `active_lifecycles`, which now re-locks `self.controller`, causing an immediate self-deadlock during web snapshot publication.

The post-stop verification pipeline runs `grep -F -- "$hel_match"` (and `$hel_match_home`) concurrently with `ps -eo args=`, allowing `grep` to match its own command line and falsely fail worker shutdown.
Requiring a model on every spawn and passing it to `apply_followup` breaks Muse sub-agents, whose model is synthesized from native settings because Muse's live ACP bridge exposes no model selector.

A replayed MCP spawn re-runs profile discovery and quota-based selection before looking up the durable registration and passes the recomputed selection instead of the registered child's model/effort to `start_followup`.

`resolve_subagent_selection` reads the parent's model and effort only from `operational.config`, missing defaults advertised only in `operational.config_options` and causing `model: "current"` to fail.
Effort validation and inheritance check against the profile's default-model discovery choices rather than the selected model's effort choices.

Spawn discovery awaits probes with a 300-second deadline while the MCP shim times out `spawn` after 120 seconds, allowing the daemon to create a child after the caller already received a timeout error.
A spawn pinned to a specific profile still awaits discovery for every other eligible profile before checking the pinned profile.
Queued handback requests carry no originating turn identity, so a delayed or timed-out handback attaches to a later active turn.
Reminder submission checks only a stale pre-job idle snapshot and submits unconditionally, allowing a stale reminder to queue behind a newly submitted follow-up task and overwrite its handback.
Skipping a reminder when queued_prompts is non-empty still marks noticed_turn, leaving waits stuck in Pending if the queued item is removed or is a non-prompt config command.
Wait report-state checks pass only active_turn and omit queued commands, so a reminder queued longer than the 30-second grace period falls back prematurely.
Any error from reminder submission, including a lost acknowledgement after worker acceptance, immediately records reminder_failed_for and causes premature fallback.
Adding handback_tool to deny_unknown_fields SubagentRecord inside RuntimeSnapshot without bumping daemon PROTOCOL_VERSION breaks previous-build protocol 33 clients.
hel_kill_tree sends SIGKILL to every captured PGID, including a legacy worker's inherited shared process group.
hel_snapshot_tree silently turns hel_ps or awk failures into an empty snapshot, allowing cleanup to proceed while separate-group harnesses are still running.
hel_snapshot_tree runs only once before TERM, so descendants spawned afterwards into a new process group are never tracked and can outlive cleanup.
hel_kill_tree sends SIGKILL to every numeric PID and PGID captured before the two-second grace period without revalidating process identity.
hel_tree_running checks only captured PIDs and ignores captured PGIDs, missing helpers spawned into a harness's process group after the snapshot once the harness PID exits.
The new teardown regression test calls leader.wait() before asserting the stop succeeded and without a cleanup guard, hanging forever if stop fails.
worker_launch_config strips parent directories from nested authentication marker paths via file_name(), breaking worker credential reconciliation for Kimi and ZCode.
SharedCatalogCache stores catalogs under (profile_id, "") in profile_config_cache, colliding with model-less profile discovery so discovery and catalog staging overwrite each other.
Reusing profile_config_cache's 24-hour TTL for catalog fallback was explicitly documented as intended behavior in this commit.
stage_codex_catalog stores an HTTP 200 response in the cache before validating it with codex_catalog::parse, poisoning the cached fallback and failing instead of falling back on invalid bodies.
stage_codex_catalog rejects standard OpenAI-compatible {"data": [...]} /models responses because codex_catalog::parse only accepts Codex's {"models": [...]} shape.
stage_codex_catalog skips catalog staging for custom providers using experimental_bearer_token instead of env_key, leaving them with OpenAI's built-in model list.
stage_profile preserves read-only permissions via std::fs::copy, causing point_config_at_catalog's std::fs::write to fail with permission denied when the source config.toml is read-only.
fetch_catalog_over_https constructs and drops reqwest::blocking::Client on the calling thread, panicking Tokio when prepare_worker_files runs inside an async runtime context.
fetch_catalog_over_https buffers the full response body via response.bytes() without a byte limit, unlike zai_usage::read_bounded.
Returning an unsupported error for HarnessKind::Zcode in quota.rs was an intentional transitional step before removing ZCode in the next milestone commit.
quota_refresh_profiles and credential_sync_targets now synchronously read and parse each Codex profile's config.toml on the dashboard UI event loop.
reconcile_session reads canonical auth.json before reconcile_connected checks authenticates_with_api_key, so an unreadable leftover auth.json aborts skills and GitHub token sync.

restore_checkpoint_with_native_state looks up only literal "model" and "effort" keys in canonical_session.session.configuration, dropping selectors stored under harness-specific option IDs such as reasoning_effort.

restore_checkpoint_with_native_state seeds RestoredRelaySeed.accepted_config from the controller's projected session.configuration rather than the relay's accepted selections, promoting unaccepted account defaults or bridge fallbacks into durable pins.
